title: spec(data): export the list-comparand operator split from @objectstack/spec/data so the flow executor reads it instead of a local copy (#29404)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

Source: the contract review of PR #29404 (card #29050), should-fix 2 / boundary (c).

`packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-operators.ts` keeps `LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` (`$in`, `$nin`, `$between`) out of the `data` barrel because "no reader exists". PR #29404 is a reader: `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts` holds a local copy, kept equal by a behavioural reconciliation test.

Ask: export the split, or a predicate over it, from `@objectstack/spec/data`, with a one-line describe. Then a server follow-up (the same card can name it) switches the executor to the import and retires the local copy and its reconciliation test. Additive export: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Lands after #29404 merges.
